summary: Complete testing of 5 new engagement and gamification features on home page: CuraStories, BrandOfTheWeek, HealthStreak, FooterBadge, and SeasonalCampaign. All backend APIs and frontend components working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for health streak testing (TEST_LOG_*, TEST_ACCUM_*, TEST_GOAL_*, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 engagement features implemented and working: 1) CuraStories - 4 story circles (DiaGyn, Orange, Mango, Wellness) with fullscreen viewer and progress bars, 2) BrandOfTheWeek - rotating card showing Orange Pharmacy this week, 3) HealthStreak - gamification widget with 21-day challenge, log buttons (3K, 5K, 8K, 10K), Google Fit connect placeholder, 4) SeasonalCampaign - 'Beat the Heat' summer campaign shown for March with dismiss functionality, 5) FooterBadge - 'Powered by Nevika Cura' at bottom. Test phone 9403890429 has active streak data.

endpoints_tested: GET /api/health-streak/{phone} - returns streak, today_steps, today_goal_reached, rewards
POST /api/health-streak/log - accumulates steps, updates streak when 10K goal reached
GET /api/health-streak/leaderboard/{portal} - returns sorted leaderboard with masked phones
